translationRepairs: On xinsi, Chongde’s west wing opened its lecture; Sun Shi and Feng Yuan expounded the Analects.
On xinsi, Chongzheng Hall’s west wing opened its lecture; Sun Shi and Feng Yuan expounded the Analects.
The Chinese names 崇政殿 (Chongzheng Hall), not Chongde Hall.
Day xinsi: for the first time the western wing of Chongde Hall held the lecture; Reader Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were ordered to lecture the Analects.
Day xinsi: for the first time the western wing of Chongzheng Hall held the lecture; Reader Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were ordered to lecture the Analects.
The Chinese names 崇政殿 (Chongzheng Hall), not Chongde Hall.
Ding Wei was removed as prince’s junior mentor and made honorary western capital official.
Ding Wei was dismissed and made junior guardian of the heir apparent with a sinecure at the western capital.
罷為太子少保 means he was dismissed and made junior guardian, not removed from that post.
Day jiazi: Feng Zheng was renamed mountain-tomb commissioner.
Day jiazi: Feng Zheng was appointed instead as mountain-tomb commissioner.
改命 means appointed in his place, not renamed.
On jimao he worshipped at the imperial academy and the temple of Marquis Wu.
On jimao he worshipped at the imperial academy and the temple of King Wucheng.
武成王廟 is the temple of King Wucheng (武成王), not a Marquis Wu.
Day jimao: he visited the Directorate of Education, paid homage to Confucius, then visited the Marquis Wu temple.
Day jimao: he visited the Directorate of Education, paid homage to Confucius, then visited the King Wucheng temple.
武成王廟 is the temple of King Wucheng (武成王), not a Marquis Wu.
Yanzhou’s eastern horse stud was closed and its pasture distributed to farmers.
Yunzhou’s Dongping horse stud was closed and its pasture distributed to farmers.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, and 東平 is the place-name Dongping.
Yanzhou’s eastern Ping horse stud was abolished and pasture given to the people.
Yunzhou’s Dongping horse stud was abolished and pasture given to the people.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, and 東平 is the place-name Dongping.

On jihai, Fuyan circuit chieftains led by Cao Shougui submitted.
鄜延 is the Fuyan circuit (Fu and Yan prefectures).

Day jihai: Fan chieftains of the Fuyan circuit, including Cao Shougui, submitted inward.
鄜延 is the Fuyan circuit (Fu and Yan prefectures), not 'Yan and Yan'.

復是年租賦 means that year's rent and taxes were exempted (復 = exempt), not restored.
